motion_rule: a full sprint on all fours down a bazaar lane at the lens, the camera racing backwards ahead so the stalls tear past every beat and his face stays to the lens; his feet never leave the stones, he moves only across the frame at the lens; ONE move per window, never a chain; head half the frame; new shot size each beat; camera move every beat
character: a lean brown macaque in a grey waistcoat, deadpan, running flat out
second_characters: ONE small macaque porter in a green visor; from 4.5 he swings on the taut chain at the lens
props: ONE brass balance beam with two identical pans, hooked on his tail; two identical brown coconuts, same size and husk, in his waistcoat
prop_continuity: the left pan drags at his knee from 1.0; the right pan shoots up at 4.05 out of frame and never comes down, its chain taut over his shoulder
environment: a packed bazaar lane, stalls of fruit and brass both sides, shoppers scattering out of his way
light_events: hard noon sun bars strobe his face every beat, cold rim both sides

audio.language: Russian, lines verbatim; latin hints never spoken
audio.delivery: dry chesty male voice, deadpan, even 4.4 syllables/sec, beats filled edge to edge
audio.pronunciation: o-DIN, po-KA-zy-va-et, na-kop-LE-ni-ya, dru-GOY, kar-MI-che-ski-e, DOL-gi
audio.pacing: 0.45-3.55 one breath; the gap under one second; 4.5-7.15 one breath with no voice sound outside the lines; after 7.15 not a word, sfx keep going
audio.lip_sync: jaws open on every syllable, never a voice over
audio.sfx: his feet hammering the stones all clip, the bazaar roaring, a woody knock at 0.45, a chain slam at 1.0, a chain whipping taut at 4.05

timeline.a: the beam swings into the lens off his tail, pans level, he is already at a full sprint
he flings a coconut into the left pan without breaking stride
the left pan slams down and the weight slings him into a harder run
he tears past the loaded pan dragging dead down at his knee
he runs flat out at the lens, the loaded pan swinging under him
he flings the other coconut into the right pan on the run, never looking at it
the right pan shoots out of the frame and he tears on down the lane, the chain snapping taut
the porter drops into the lens on that chain and swings across the frame beside his ear
the porter hauls himself hand over hand along the chain past the lens
the porter throws his whole weight on the chain and it stays taut, the hero sprinting under it
he whips the sunk pan past the lens on the run
he cuts hard across the lane through a stall and the fruit sprays past the lens
he flings a fruit crate onto the risen pan on the run and it takes that up too
he swings the sunk pan across the lens on the run
he throws himself into the lens, deadpan, the sunk pan at his ear

must_appear: two identical coconuts: the first drags the left pan down, the second sends the right pan up out of frame and it never comes back; the hero stays on his feet the whole clip; at 9.4 his deadpan face is in the lens
negative_prompt: speech bubble, subtitles, watermark, letterbox, horizontal bars, night, dark scene, a walking hero, a hero lifted off his feet, a hero moving up or down the frame, standing bystanders, a still background, a parked camera, a hero standing to work on a prop, a wide or distant hero, a hero seen from behind, a held pose, slow motion, the risen pan coming down, a word not in the lines, a drawn-out word, cyrillic letters, extra limbs
